column1: # Cosmos DB token forms for generated compat rows: the text written for each
# token of sql.g4 that is a class of texts. Keywords (K_*) and punctuation
# spell themselves and need no row. Each note cites the lexer rule in sql.g4.
# A sample of one name, string, number or parameter stands for its class when
# the grammar judge reads a statement.

column3: sql.g4:295 [a-zA-Z_]([a-zA-Z_]|DIGIT)*; the rule's first alternative is empty, which a lexer never emits
sql.g4:270 a single- or double-quoted string with JSON's escapes
sql.g4:265 digits, with an optional sign, fraction and exponent
